chunks: Al-Bazanti narrated from Al-Muthanna, from Al-Hasan Al-Sayqal, from Abu Abdullah عليه السلام, who said:
I said to him: A nephew and a grandfather. He said: The estate is between them in two equal halves.

key_terms.ابْنُ أَخٍ: paternal nephew as an heir in the inheritance case

ai.seo_question: How is an inheritance divided between a nephew and a grandfather in Shia fiqh?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling in inheritance concerning the case of a nephew and a grandfather. Imam Abu Abdullah عليه السلام states that the estate is divided equally between them, with each receiving one half.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.5647 - Al-Bazanti narrated from Al-Muthanna from Al-Hasan Al-Ṣayqal from Abu Abdullah (as) who said:

I asked Imam (as) about a paternal nephew and a grandfather (regarding inheritance).
Imam (as) said: "The inheritance is divided equally between them, half and half."
